description: An HTML document serving as the user interface for a database viewer. It contains elements for displaying and managing database tables, including loading states, error messages, and a responsive layout with interactive features.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases and updates the interface accordingly.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the databases from the API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Loads tables for a specific database and updates the UI.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Loads and displays data from a selected table in a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the data in a table format in the UI.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell values in the data table.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands a cell to show more information upon clicking.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading message within a specified element.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Displays an error message within a specified element.

methods.name: showEmptyState
methods.description: Displays an empty state message within a specified element.

methods.name: setActiveState
methods.description: Sets the active state on selected database items.
